text:
Emma: FYI: Partner (EdgeWorks) just asked how we handle replays vs credits when devices buffer and resend. They often send duplicate readings and sometimes replay a whole 24h window. Can we align on policy before we flip them to prod?

Raj: Short answer: we accept replays, dedupe by source_batch_id OR idempotency_key. If neither present, we fall back to sha256(device_id + : + hour_bucket). Need to document TTL and credit semantics.

Deirdre: Important: business wants to avoid accidental double-billing. Proposal: for up to 72h after original event timestamp we dedupe and do not create extra ledger charges. After 72h, late arrivals become adjustment entries and require manual review if they change billed usage. Thoughts?

Luis: 72h grace window seems reasonable. But partner SLAs mention buffering up to 7 days for some customers. Can we support longer for specific partners via a flag?

Raj: We can make grace_window configurable per-partner. Default 72h, partner_override up to 7 days requires legal sign-off & billing acceptance.

partner-integration: Implementation notes from EdgeWorks: they will send these fields:
```json
{
  "device_id": "ew-0001",
  "timestamp": "2026-03-19T14:00:00Z",
  "cpu_hours": 1.25,
  "batch_id": "batch-20260319-14-000",
  "sequence_number": 42,
  "signature": "hmac_sha256(...)"
}
```
They may also include sequence_number increments per device for stronger dedupe. They will send X-Partner-Signature header too.

Emma: We should require one of (batch_id OR sequence_number) for playback safety. If neither, reject with 422 and ask partner to include a replay identifier. Also require signature header for authenticity.

Deirdre: Reconciliation rules (draft):
- Write ledger rows with: partner_id, hashed_device_id, usage_unit (compute_unit_hours), source_batch_id (if present), seq_num (if present), original_timestamp, ingest_ts, dedupe_key.
- Upsert behavior: if dedupe_key exists and ingested before, ignore duplicated usage.
- If a later event arrives within grace_window but with a higher sequence_number and different cpu_hours, override previous ledger row and emit adjustment record. No extra invoice until billing cycle close.

Luis: How do we surface adjustments to finance? Need an adjustments queue + nightly report to finance team and a flag on ledger rows: adjustment_pending.

BillingBot: Auto-note: create ticket FIN-EDGE-<date> when adjustment_pending true for >0 entries for partner.

Raj: Reconciliation job: daily job that aggregates by partner/sku/hour and compares ledger sums vs partner-reported aggregates (partners can provide hourly rollups). If delta > 0.5% or >10 compute_unit_hours, create an investigation alert.

partner-integration: EdgeWorks can produce hourly rollups and a signed rollup manifest. Good idea to compare.

Emma: Security: verify X-Partner-Signature using partner public key. Reject 401 if signature invalid. Also rate-limit replays separately to protect ingestion pipeline.

Deirdre: API responses and partner expectations:
- 202 Accepted for valid payloads (include batch_id and received_count in body)
- 400 Bad Request for malformed JSON
- 401 Unauthorized for invalid signature
- 409 Conflict if batch_id already processed (include existing_ingest_ts)
- 422 Unprocessable Entity if missing replay identifier on replay mode

Luis: Ops: add metrics: partner.replays.received, partner.replays.duplicates, partner.adjustments.created, partner.reconciliation.deltas. Hook these into PagerDuty when reconciliation failures spike.

Emma: Action items:
- Raj: add idempotency helper lib + dedupe_key docs (ETA 3d)
- Deirdre: update billing contract appendix with grace_window defaults & override process (ETA 4d)
- Luis: set up alerts + metrics and adjustments queue (ETA 5d)
- partner-integration: confirm they will include batch_id or sequence_number and the public key (ETA 2d)

partner-integration: Confirmed. We'll include batch_id OR seq_num for all replays and upload public key today. We can also provide hourly rollups starting next week.

Emma: OK, we'll draft a short partner runbook and send to EdgeWorks. Sync Thursday 9am to approve contract appendix. Thanks all!
